lead.en: Papers for the Mount Sinai EHR project.
lead.zh: Mount Sinai 电子病历项目的论文。

nodes.label: Delphi-2M
nodes.title: Learning the natural history of human disease with generative transformers

oneliner.en: Delphi-2M turns GPT-2 into a continuous-time, competing-risk generative model of multi-morbidity: given a person's sequence of first ICD-10 diagnoses (1,256 diseases + death) plus sex/BMI/smoking/alcohol, it predicts both what the next event is and when it happens. Trained on 0.4M UK Biobank participants with only 2.2M parameters, it reaches an average age-stratified AUC of ~0.76 across >1,000 diseases, 0.67 on 1.93M Danish individuals with no parameter changes, and can sample synthetic health trajectories up to 20 years ahead.
oneliner.zh: Delphi-2M 把 GPT-2 改造成连续时间、多病种竞争风险的生成模型:输入一个人的 ICD-10 首诊序列(1,256 种疾病 + 死亡)及性别/BMI/吸烟/饮酒,同时输出下一事件是什么以及何时发生;在 40 万 UK Biobank 参与者上训练、仅 220 万参数,对 >1,000 种疾病的平均年龄分层 AUC 约 0.76,不改参数迁移到 193 万丹麦人上仍有 0.67,还能采样未来 20 年的合成健康轨迹。

nodes.label: Pancreatic cancer trajectories
nodes.title: A deep learning algorithm to predict risk of pancreatic cancer from disease trajectories

oneliner.en: CancerRiskNet: using only timestamped ICD diagnosis-code sequences (disease trajectories), a Transformer trained on the Danish National Patient Registry (6.2M patients, 23,985 pancreatic cancer cases) predicts pancreatic cancer risk within 3/6/12/36/60 months. 36-month AUROC is 0.879, and still 0.83 when the last 3 months before diagnosis are excluded; transferred as-is to the US Veterans Affairs system it falls to 0.71, recovering to 0.78 after local retraining — showing both that temporal order carries signal and that models do not transfer across health systems for free.
oneliner.zh: CancerRiskNet:只用带时间戳的 ICD 诊断码序列(disease trajectory),在丹麦全国患者登记(620 万人,23,985 例胰腺癌)上训练 Transformer,预测 3/6/12/36/60 个月内发生胰腺癌的风险;36 个月 AUROC 0.879,排除确诊前 3 个月数据后仍有 0.83;直接迁移到美国退伍军人系统(US-VA)跌到 0.71,本地重训后回到 0.78 —— 明确证明「时间顺序」有信息量,也明确证明「跨医疗系统不能直接搬模型」。

nodes.label: APOLLO virtual patient
nodes.title: A multimodal and temporal foundation model for virtual patient representations at healthcare system scale

oneliner.en: APOLLO (Mahmood lab): a multimodal temporal Transformer pretrained with masked modelling on 33 years of records from 17 Mass General Brigham hospitals — 7.2M patients, 25.3B medical events, 28 modalities (structured codes, labs, vitals, medications, note and report text, pathology/blood-smear images) — compressing a whole care journey into a "virtual patient" embedding. Frozen embeddings with a linear Cox head substantially beat an age–sex baseline across 261 prognostic and 61 retrieval tasks on a 1.4M-patient test set.
oneliner.zh: APOLLO(Mahmood 组):在 Mass General Brigham 17 家医院 33 年、720 万病人、253 亿条医疗事件、28 种模态(结构化码、化验、生命体征、用药、病程记录与报告文本、病理/血涂片图像)上做掩码预训练的多模态时间 Transformer,把整个就医历程压成一个「虚拟病人」向量;冻结向量 + 线性 Cox 头在 140 万人测试集的 261 个预后任务和 61 个检索任务上大幅超过年龄-性别基线。

nodes.label: COMET (EHR + omics)
nodes.title: A machine learning approach to leveraging electronic health records for enhanced omics analysis

oneliner.en: COMET (Aghaeepour lab, Stanford): omics studies often have tens to hundreds of samples while the same hospital's EHR covers tens of thousands — pretrain a GRU on the large EHR-only cohort, transfer its weights into a multimodal EHR + omics network that blends early and late fusion, and both prediction and the biological plausibility of selected proteins improve, in a 61-person pregnancy proteomics cohort and a 559-person UK Biobank cancer proteomics cohort.
oneliner.zh: COMET(Aghaeepour 组,Stanford):组学研究往往只有几十到几百个样本,而同一医院的 EHR 有几万人 —— 先在「只有 EHR」的大队列上预训练一个 GRU,再把权重迁移进 EHR + 组学的多模态网络(早融合与晚融合混合),在 61 人妊娠蛋白组和 559 人 UK Biobank 癌症蛋白组上都提升了预测,并让模型挑出的蛋白更符合已知生物学。

nodes.label: LLM-embedding pancreatic risk
nodes.title: Enhancing EHR-based pancreatic cancer prediction with LLM-derived embeddings

oneliner.en: In a CancerRiskNet-style pancreatic cancer trajectory Transformer, replace randomly initialized code embeddings with LLM text embeddings of OMOP concept names (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small): on two US institutional EHRs — Columbia (CUMC) and Cedars-Sinai (CSMC) — 6–12-month AUROC rises from 0.59/0.82 to 0.67/0.86, and to 0.82/0.89 once data from the 0–3 months before diagnosis are excluded.
oneliner.zh: 在 CancerRiskNet 式的胰腺癌轨迹 Transformer 里,把随机初始化的诊断码嵌入换成LLM 对 OMOP 概念名称的文本嵌入(OpenAI text-embedding-3-small),在 Columbia(CUMC)与 Cedars-Sinai(CSMC)两家美国院内 EHR 上,6–12 个月预测 AUROC 分别从 0.59/0.82 提升到 0.67/0.86;再排除确诊前 0–3 个月数据,升到 0.82/0.89。
